QuestInfo.name: [New Year Event] Happy New Years - Time To Make a Wish!
QuestInfo.0: Little Draco will grant you one wish to celebrate the new year. Click on the Renegade notice to the left to make a wish.
QuestInfo.1: Stay online with #bLittle Draco's crystal#k for #ran hour#k to transform it into a magical star. But don't log off! The star will lose its powers.
QuestInfo.2: Little Dragon is still a black dragon after all. You made a wish and received a gift.
